name: Floating Hollow
source:
Elzy's education isn't just academic – it's arcane. She's being trained for something strange, ancient, and barely understood. But the one who teaches her may be more dangerous than the theory itself.

[From [url=https://sporktownhero.itch.io/floating-hollow]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
埃尔齐的教育不仅仅是学术性的，而且是神秘的。她正在接受一些奇怪的、古老的、几乎无法理解的事情的训练。但教导她的人可能比理论本身更危险。

[来自[url=https://sporktownhero.itch.io/floating-hollow]Itch.io[/url]]
